description: This file defines the CandidateView class, a custom Android View used for displaying and interacting with suggested words in a soft keyboard application.

classes.name: CandidateView
classes.description: A custom View for displaying suggestion candidates in a soft keyboard, handling touch and gesture interactions, and rendering suggestion text with highlights.

methods.name: CandidateView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CandidateView, setting up resources, paint, gesture detector, and view properties.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Sets the SoftKeyboard service for callback interactions.

methods.name: computeHorizontalScrollRange
methods.description: Returns the total width of the suggestions for scrolling purposes.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's dimensions based on content and constraints.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the suggestion words, highlights selected suggestion, and manages scrolling.

methods.name: scrollToTarget
methods.description: Animates scrolling to the target scroll position.

methods.name: setSuggestions
methods.description: Updates the suggestion list and resets scroll position.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the suggestion list and resets selection.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch interactions for selecting suggestions and scrolling.

methods.name: takeSuggestionAt
methods.description: Selects a suggestion based on flick gesture x-coordinate.
